# Regular expressions matched against "<where>: <kind>: <text>". One per line.
# Only for text that is provably not personal (licence boilerplate, test
# placeholders). Never add a real name, path or address here.
# The (L)GPL texts' example "James Random Hacker".
^(.*/)?(LICENSE|COPYING|L?GPL[-\w.]*)(\.\w+)?:\d+: first name: James$
# ScanRuler's upstream author (Stefan Hermann / CNC Kitchen): his public business addresses.
: email: (stefan|contact)@cnckitchen\.com$
